claims.head: The Maple Leafs can’t afford to take penalties
claims.call: The Oilers’ power play creates at least their usual 9.8 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Oilers’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Maple Leafs’ kill is near the bottom. The Maple Leafs need to stay out of the box. Edmonton has had one of the league’s most effective power plays for years.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 21% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Oliver Ekman-Larsson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 30% of the team’s shorthanded time in 12 games, up from 6% last season.
Kasperi Kapanen has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 50% of the team’s power-play time in 10 games, up from 6% last season.
Ty Emberson is no longer killing penalties: 2% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, down from 30% last season.

stakes: The Maple Leafs go in tied for second in the Atlantic with 14 points, the Oilers first in the Pacific with 17 points.

EDM.head: The matchup suits the Oilers
EDM.body: Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Maple Leafs’ way back in is a power play that gets going.

TOR.head: The Maple Leafs face a real test
TOR.body: Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Maple Leafs’ best way through is a power play that gets going.

story.head: Who’s in net for the Oilers?
paras: Both teams come in on a three-game winning streak.
The Oilers’ power play has a soft target in the Maple Leafs’ kill. The Oil’s defensemen shoot a lot, and the Maple Leafs’ not so much.

items.text: Auston Matthews is two points from 800.
William Nylander is two goals from 300.
The Maple Leafs are newly without Nick Blankenburg, and have been without Chris Tanev and John Tavares for several games.
